objects.taxonomy_description: Cylindrical or rectangular container with an open top, typically 40-100 cm tall and 30-60 cm in diameter. Constructed from metal (galvanized steel, aluminum), plastic, or wood. The body has smooth vertical walls with a flat or slightly domed bottom. Some models feature a hinged or removable lid, foot pedal mechanism, or swing-top opening. Surface is typically painted (gray, green, black, or blue) with a matte or semi-gloss finish. May have a carrying handle on the rim or molded grip indentations. The silhouette is a simple upright cylinder or rectangular prism.

objects.taxonomy_description: Domestic swine measuring 90-180 cm body length weighing 50-350 kg. Body stocky and barrel-shaped with sparse coarse bristles over pink, black, or spotted skin. Head large with elongated snout ending in cartilaginous disk for rooting. Eyes small. Ears large and floppy or erect depending on breed. Legs short and stout with cloven hooves. Tail short and curly. Inherited mammal traits include endothermy, sparse hair, mammary glands, and four-chambered heart. Omnivorous with highly developed olfactory sense.
